en: Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a wide avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with balconies. There are shopfronts on the right, people in traditional clothing walking along the street, and a horse‑drawn carriage in the distance. Large trees and what appears to be a church or large building are visible further down the road. The caption at the top left identifies the location, and a modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.
